traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Urtica (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.44 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 2 records in 1 source); trunks 0.44, branches 0.46. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: The Flora of North America's account of Urtica, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): staminate flowers with 4 tepals, distinct and equal, and 4 stamens; pistillate flowers with 4 tepals, the inner 2 as long as the achene and the outer 2 smaller. Four tepals in two pairs are two whorls of two.
